messages:
Maria_Sales: Heads up — Cabana Health legal emailed asking for a SOC 2 summary, ISO27001 cert excerpt, and a signed pen-test letter that explicitly covers our Dedicated POC environment. They want everything by EOD Wed. Any blockers?
Sam_Security: @Maria I can draft the pen-test attestation. Quick Q — is the POC on Dedicated single-tenant or hosted? Scope/wording changes based on that.
Maria_Sales: Dedicated pool for the POC. They also asked for staging IPs, SAML SSO metadata, and KMS separation notes.
Raj_Engineer: For Dedicated we need to confirm egress/IP model — will Cabana provide an allowlist or do we route from static egress? Also confirm whether we give ephemeral staging creds or presigned uploads. Ops prefers presigned S3.
Elaine_Docs: SOC2 summary link (internal): https://redwood-internal/docs/soc2-summary.pdf — contains control mapping. ISO cert image + scope doc are in the team drive; I'll attach to the ticket. Legal: do you need a redacted scanned certificate or the original?
Nina_Legal: We can provide a redacted ISO cert excerpt. Pen-test letter needs Legal sign-off; we also need to verify NDA/PO existence before signing. If those are in place, we can sign within ~48h.
deploy-bot: New ticket created: POC-524 — evidence collection and pen-test coordination.
Maria_Sales: Cabana says NDA + PO are uploaded to their shared dropbox link: https://dropbox.com/s/xxxxx — I confirmed.
Tom_Finance: From pricing side — Cabana asked if Dedicated POC includes a trial discount. We can offer 20% off the first month for POC customers <90 days, subject to revenue ops approval. Note: Dedicated onboarding + SRE hours for on-prem/residency requirement are billable.
Raj_Engineer: Operational checklist: 1) Provide staging IPs and CIDR for allowlist 2) Create SAML SSO metadata (IdP test) 3) Document KMS separation and key scope 4) Plan oncall window for pen-test. Who owns the runbook?
Sam_Security: I'll own the pen-test coordination and draft the letter. Draft excerpt below (will share full letter in the ticket):
```
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference confirms that a one-time penetration test may be performed against the Dedicated POC environment scoped to application endpoints and associated infrastructure for the dates XX/XX-XX/XX. Testing must exclude attempts to access production data stores. Redwood will provide a contact for coordination and will not be liable for testing outside the agreed scope. Signed: Legal / CISO
```
Sam_Security: Need to know who signs (Legal or CISO). Nina_Legal: Legal signs; CISO can be listed as point of contact.
Maria_Sales: Cabana also asked whether the pen-test letter can be backdated to account for their procurement timeline — legal ok with issuance date but not falsifying dates.
Nina_Legal: We will not backdate. We can include statement that testing window may be scheduled retroactively if both parties agree, but issuance date will be current.
Raj_Engineer: One more blocker: if Cabana requires SOC2 scope cover for on-prem later, that triggers an audit gap assessment and possible SRE retainer. Flagging for sales.
Tom_Finance: Noted. I can pre-approve the 20% POC discount; escalate the SRE retainer to RevOps if they request enterprise residency.
Maria_Sales: Action items: Sam to post full pen-test letter draft in POC-524; Elaine to attach SOC2/ISO artifacts; Raj to prepare staging IP list and runbook; Nina to queue legal signature once docs are validated; Tom to confirm POC discount in the quote. Goal: deliver initial packet to Cabana by EOD Wed. :thumbsup:
Sam_Security: Will do. Posting draft in ticket now. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Ticket POC-524 updated with attachments: soc2-summary.pdf, iso-excerpt.png, pen-test-draft.docx
